reason: Packing the washed greens in the meal box is the only offered combination and directly serves the goal of taking garden food along.
expectation: I expect the greens to be packed for the flight and the garden goal to complete.

effect: The greens became a flight meal and completed the chapter, as expected; the image places the garden beside the ice sample for departure.
reaction: The small click of the box and the leaves beside the ice made a pleasing, quiet farewell, though the action itself offered no decision.

mostWorthwhile.text: Packing the leaves beside the ice made the two strands of the expedition feel connected in a simple, tangible image.

leastWorthwhile.text: The single packing action was entirely predictable and offered no puzzle or choice, so it was slight as gameplay.

surprise.text: Nothing in this chapter surprised me; the packed meal was what I expected.

arbitrary.text: No: putting washed greens in a meal box has a clear purpose, even though it was the only option.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue to see what Earth makes of the body in the ice, although this chapter alone gave me little gameplay to explore.
